name: Create or update case
description: Find the case of an external incident and update it, or create the case. The incident is identified by the tag ext:<source>:<external_id> on its case. An open case is updated: the priority can only go up, the tags are added, the empty custom fields are filled and the comment is posted, its status never changes. A closed case only gets the comment

source.description: Tool the incident comes from (e.g. sentinel, servicenow). Part of the incident tag ext:<source>:<external_id>

external_id.description: Identifier of the incident in its source. Part of the incident tag ext:<source>:<external_id>

title.description: Title of the case, when it is created

description.description: Description of the case, when it is created

priority.description: Custom priority of the case: its name (e.g. High) or its UUID. On an existing case, only a higher priority is applied

tags.description: Tags to add to the case

custom_fields.description: Custom fields of the case, as {"Field name": value}. Options of the select fields are given by their label. On an existing case, only the empty fields are filled

assignees.description: UUIDs of the avatars to assign to the case, when it is created

template_uuid.description: UUID of a case template to apply, when the case is created

comment.description: Comment to post on an existing case, open or closed

community_uuid.description: Community of the case. The case is only searched in this community

outcome.description: created: a new case was created. updated: the case of the incident was found and updated, or commented when closed

matched_by.description: How the case was found: external_id. Null when the case was created

case.description: The case, as returned by Get case
